item.title: Stamp Your Way Around BCCLS — Wed Jul 22 — Glen Ridge - Adult Reading Room
item.description:
Summer Fun for Everyone
Explore the 78 BCCLS Member Libraries in search of hidden treasures!
Join the 2026 BCCLS Scavenger Hunt - a fun-filled journey to discover the BCCLS logo hidden in participating libraries.
Here’s how it works:
Pick up your scavenger hunt form at the Tenafly Library starting June 15.
Visit at least 3 libraries between June 15 and August 15, 2026, and find the hidden BCCLS logo.
Get your form stamped with each library’s property stamp as proof of your discovery!
Return your form to any BCCLS library by August 29, 2026.
Visit at least 3 libraries (2 in addition to the Tenafly Library) and you may win a $50 Visa Gift Card.
One for an adult (18 ) and one for a child.

item.title: World Movie Night: It Was Just an Accident — Thu Jul 23, 6:30 PM — West Orange - Community Room 2
item.description:
Watch and read your way around the world with us this summer with our World Movie Night and World Literature series!
Playing in our World Championship Challenge? Here's a fine Group D pick for your consideration:
IT WAS JUST AN ACCIDENT (2025) directed by Jafar Panahi (Iran) PG-13, 1h 44min
A mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his jailhouse tormentor. Panicked, he rounds up a few of his fellow ex-prisoners to confirm the man's identity. Written and directed by acclaimed Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi, the film was nominated for two Academy Awards and won the Palme D'Or Award at Cannes, the NY Film Critics Circle Award for Best Director, and the Audience Award for World Cinema at the Montclair Film Festival.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10341
